description: Implementation of the LearningTaskController class for managing learning tasks, including data collection, model training, and prediction within the media learning module.

classes.name: LearningTaskControllerImpl
classes.description: Implements the logic for managing a learning task, including data collection, model training, and prediction.

methods.name: LearningTaskControllerImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the learning task controller with task details, reporter, and feature provider.

methods.name: BeginObservation
methods.description: Starts a new observation with given features and optional source ID.

methods.name: CompleteObservation
methods.description: Completes an observation with specified completion details.

methods.name: PredictDistribution
methods.description: Predicts the distribution for given features and runs callback with result.

methods.name: AddFinishedExample
methods.description: Adds a completed example to training data, triggers model training if conditions are met.

methods.name: OnModelTrained
methods.description: Callback invoked after model training completes, updates current model.

methods.name: SetTrainerForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom trainer for testing purposes.

methods.name: DoFeatureSubsetSelection
methods.description: Randomly selects a subset of features and adjusts task descriptions accordingly.
